title: See New York City Ballet at Lincoln Center

location.label: New York City Ballet, New York

description: Take your seat at the David H. Koch Theater and watch New York City Ballet turn timing and movement into a conversation. A program may pair different works, giving you contrasting music and choreography in one evening. Notice the corps moving together, then the individual character of each dancer when the stage opens up.
teaser: Watch choreography and live music meet at Lincoln Center.
goodToKnow: Choose a current ballet program and seats that suit your visit; repertoire changes through the season.
whyItMightDelightYou: You need no ballet vocabulary to enjoy the patterns, athleticism, and sudden shifts in mood.
